objective: Promote the inactive Phase 2A Command Agent through a controlled Phase 2B pilot and into an explicitly authorized Phase 3 read-and-draft implementation.

freezeBaseline.policy: No additional Phase 2A product capability. Only verification, release-evidence remediation, and defects that prevent the controlled pilot may change.

steps.title: Freeze Phase 2A repository functionality
steps.proofRequired: Independent review of the exact frozen commit attestation; clean release and protected CI remain a separate promotion point.
steps.currentEvidence: Commit 85eb50ef792908ae1e3ecbe7bd34b6054c79cf52 is bound to the 207-file manifest: 207 verified, zero missing or unexpected paths, zero content mismatches, and zero post-freeze Phase 2A runtime drift. The current worktree remains dirty and is not a clean release artifact.
steps.nextAction: Review and accept the freeze attestation. Do not fold the current dirty worktree into the frozen release identity.

steps.title: Produce a clean immutable release and CI artifact
steps.proofRequired: Protected CI run, clean commit SHA, immutable artifact digest, browser certificate, deployment reference, and external CI attestation.
steps.currentEvidence: The frozen source commit is verified, but the current worktree is dirty and no protected CI run, immutable deployed artifact digest, browser certificate bound to that artifact, or external CI attestation exists.
steps.nextAction: Create and review a release commit, run protected CI, publish the inactive artifact, then run npm run agent:ci-release:evidence:apply.

steps.title: Record product and security approvals
steps.proofRequired: Distinct real directory identities and approvals bound to the frozen manifest, artifact, and evidence bundle.
steps.nextAction: Obtain both approvals from the authoritative governance system and run npm run agent:governance:evidence:apply.

steps.title: Assign six operational owner roles
steps.proofRequired: Primary and backup identities, accepted runbook, active coverage window, and escalation reference for every role.
steps.currentEvidence: All six roles exist structurally, but thirty-six owner evidence fields remain unresolved.
steps.nextAction: Record accepted assignments for ROLLOUT, ROLLBACK, SUPPORT, PILOT, SECURITY_INCIDENT, and ON_CALL_BACKUP.

steps.title: Deploy the reconciler and scheduler authority
steps.proofRequired: Five-minute managed schedule, bounded timeout, concurrency or lease control, failure alert, and independent deployment attestation.
steps.currentEvidence: Scheduler controls exist in code; no deployed authority evidence is configured.
steps.nextAction: Deploy the inactive pilot workload and scheduler evidence endpoint, then run npm run agent:scheduler:evidence:apply.

steps.title: Configure managed reconciler and scheduler evidence credentials
steps.proofRequired: Managed secret references and query-free HTTPS endpoints; no secret values in evidence.
steps.currentEvidence: Preflights stop at RECONCILER_BASE_URL_MISSING and SCHEDULER_EVIDENCE_URL_MISSING.
steps.nextAction: Configure the production-like environment through the deployment secret manager.

steps.title: Capture three consecutive reconciler windows
steps.proofRequired: Three completed, unique, five-minute windows plus healthy readiness, heartbeat, and invalid-auth rejection.
steps.nextAction: Run the deployed schedule for at least three windows, then run npm run agent:reconciler:evidence:apply.

steps.title: Deploy and test production-like alerting
steps.proofRequired: HTTPS delivery, external request identity, SLO acknowledgement, retry, dead letter, recovery, escalation, and secret rotation.
steps.nextAction: Exercise the real alert transport and run npm run agent:alert:evidence:apply.

steps.title: Complete credential rotation and revocation
steps.proofRequired: All configured classes rotated, workloads restarted, new versions verified, old versions revoked and rejected, with security approval.
steps.currentEvidence: Fifteen credential classes and thirty-one credential-gate blockers remain unresolved.
steps.nextAction: Complete the security runbook, then run npm run agent:credential-rotation:evidence:apply and npm run agent:credential-rotation:gate.

steps.title: Close statutory release evidence
steps.proofRequired: Source artifact hash verification and qualified expert approval.
steps.nextAction: Attach the verified source artifact and expert approval, then run npm run statutory:country-pack:gate.

steps.title: Rerun enterprise release gate 017
steps.proofRequired: Independent GO decision over one frozen evidence bundle.
steps.currentEvidence: Rerun remains REJECTED / NO-GO. All 37 authorized repository requirements pass, but Phase 2B entry has 19 blockers, Phase 3 entry has 32 blockers, credential rotation has 31 blockers across 15 classes, operational release has 152 blockers, and the global release index has six release blockers.
steps.nextAction: Rerun only after steps 1 through 10 pass and the operational register is ready for independent review.

steps.title: Conduct controlled Phase 2B pilot
steps.proofRequired: Separately authorized activation, allowlisted tenants and roles, monitored operation, rollback exercise, support evidence, and no unresolved high-severity incident.
steps.currentEvidence: No package is active and no pilot has started.
steps.nextAction: After a gate-017 GO, conduct the protected activation ceremony and run the bounded pilot.

steps.title: Record explicit Phase 3 GO decision
steps.proofRequired: Product, security, finance-domain, and release authority acceptance of the Phase 2B exit report.
steps.nextAction: Review pilot exit metrics and record a release-bound Phase 3 decision.

steps.title: Begin Phase 3 Cash/Reconciliation Agent
steps.proofRequired: Approved read-and-draft scope with no direct posting, payment, statutory filing, permission change, or direct Prisma business write.
steps.nextAction: After step 13, implement read tools, AgentActionDraft, evidence binding, and a non-executing reconciliation draft card.
